/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/forma-browser/libs && apt-get download libavahi-common3 libavahi-client3 libwayland-server0 libfribidi0 libxi6 && for file in *.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$file" extracted; done'

/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/forma-browser/libs && apt-get download fontconfig-config fonts-dejavu-core && for file in fontconfig-config*.deb fonts-dejavu-core*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$file" extracted; done
